data.name: The Red Disciples
data.detailed_description:
The Red Disciples is a dark, system-driven open world experience about power, belief and control.

You were chosen from an ordinary life.
But this was no coincidence.

Selected by hidden elites operating behind the scenes, you are now part of something far greater.

🔺 BUILD YOUR OWN CULT

Walk the streets, approach people and bring them into your fold.
Every person is a potential disciple. Every disciple is a piece of your growing power.

  • Persuade, manipulate, or force NPCs into submission

  • Earn their loyalty… or exploit their fear

  • Establish your own hierarchy and expand your network

🧠 DEEP FOLLOWER MANAGEMENT

Your disciples are not just followers - they are your instruments.

  • Assign them to different roles and operations

  • Infiltrate politics, media, law enforcement and institutions

  • Control production, resources, and financial systems

  • Run covert operations, gather intel and expand your influence

Every decision you make has real consequences.

🔫 POWER ISN’T BUILT ON FAITH ALONE

What you believe matters.
But what you do matters more.

  • Carry out assassinations

  • Raid locations and eliminate rivals

  • Extort businesses and dominate the underground

  • Use violence when necessary

The city won’t just fall under your control - it will submit to it.

🌆 A LIVING OPEN WORLD

Explore a vast, California-inspired open world:

  • Move freely across the city

  • Encounter different power structures in each district

  • Observe how people react to your presence

  • Expand your influence neighborhood by neighborhood

🔍 UNRAVEL THE MYSTERY

This is more than a rise to power.

Discover hidden truths through:

  • books

  • notes

  • mysterious objects

Who chose you?
Why were you selected?
And what is the true purpose behind it all?

🏛️ THE ENDGAME: CONTROL

Your goal is not just to grow.

Your goal is to control.

  • Influence the economy

  • Shape politics

  • Control the media

  • Bend the system to your will

And eventually…

Become the one who decides the fate of the nation.

🔥 FINAL LINE

Power is not given.
It is taken.

And now…
you are in the game.

data.short_description: Build your own cult in a living open world. Recruit followers, infiltrate institutions, expand your influence and use strategy or violence to rise from the streets and take control of the system.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Czech
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel i3 7th, AMD Ryzen 1xxx series
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 or RX 550
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Integrated GPUs require additional 2GB of system RAM. These estimates may change in the final release.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel i5 7th, AMD Ryzen 3xxx series
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080 or RX 6600
  • Storage: 80 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Integrated GPUs require additional 2GB of system RAM. These estimates may change in the final release.
